title: Benchmark task record
description: One resolved GitHub issue used to evaluate the agent.

repo_url.description: GitHub URL of the target repo

base_commit.description: Commit SHA immediately BEFORE the real fix was merged — this is the state the agent starts from

issue_body.description: Full issue text as the agent will see it

fix_commit.description: Commit SHA of the real merged fix. Used to derive the 'test patch' -- the diff to test files only -- which gets applied on top of base_commit before the agent starts. This is what makes fail_to_pass_tests actually fail at the start: the test exists, the source fix doesn't yet.

gold_patch_url.description: Link to the actual merged PR/commit that fixed it — used for your own reference only, never shown to the agent

test_command.description: Shell command run inside the sandbox to check the fix, e.g. 'pytest tests/test_parser.py -k test_edge_case'

fail_to_pass_tests.description: Test names that FAIL on base_commit and must PASS after a correct fix. This is what actually verifies resolution.

pass_to_pass_tests.description: Optional: tests that already pass on base_commit and must keep passing (catches regressions)

difficulty_notes.description: Your own note on why this task is easy/medium/hard — useful later for failure-mode analysis
